state.context: R55: R52c portable timeout fix delivered. JG R52b macOS reproducibility test identified that GNU timeout is missing on macOS, causing a 24x exit-127 failure cascade. R52c introduces a portable timeout resolver in tests/run_tests.sh and bin/smoke-test.sh: (a) command-v lookup of timeout then gtimeout; (b) functional probe (cmd 1 true must return 0) added in R52c-final after dog-fooding caught a shadow-binary case where command-v alone selected a non-functional timeout; (c) actionable exit-2 with platform-specific resolution if no candidate is usable; (d) NO_TIMEOUT=1 explicit local-eval fallback with four WARNING lines; (e) --kill-after=5s grace; (f) smoke-test preflight aligned with runner. Three scenarios validated: Linux native 25/25 PASS, NO_TIMEOUT=1 25/25 PASS with WARNINGs, macOS no-timeout PATH-shadow simulation -> exit 2 with actionable error. Documentation updated across README/QUICKSTART/TROUBLESHOOTING/CHANGELOG/RELEASE_STATUS. Old R52A and R52B logs moved to internal/superseded_logs/ and labeled SUPERSEDED. R52C_PORTABILITY_REPORT.md documents fix, validation matrix, and open items. Awaiting Lao Xiang R52c re-review, JG real-macOS verification (gtimeout branch), and Anan Gate 7 ruling.
